sources.citation: Pelkey, Jamin R. 2011. A Phula Comparative Lexicon: Phola, Phuza, Muji, Phowa, Azha. SIL Language and Culture Documentation and Description 18. Dallas: SIL International. 144 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent (zero occurrences of stress/accent). Thopho appears only on the clade map (p.3) and in sec. 4.6 p.15 (split from Core Muji). Sec. 3.3 pp.8-9 sketches the SISTER lect Southern Muji (PJZ): {(C)(V)VT} syllable, five pitch contrasts /55 33 13 21 52/, sandhi, non-contrastive tense voice; no Thopho phonology.
